item.title: Museum celebrates history of snow sports in West Virginia
item.description: The Snow Sports Museum of West Virginia in Canaan Valley has spent nearly a decade preserving the history of skiing in the Appalachian Mountains.

item.title: United Hospital Center promotes National Organ Donor Day
item.description: Along with Valentine's Day, Saturday, Feb. 14 is National Donor Day, and United Hospital Center (UHC) is joining the movement in order to spread awareness and education throughout north central West Virginia.

item.title: Bridgeport Fire Department to hire 6 new employees
item.description: In the first six months, the city has raised nearly half of the projected total of $600,000 in fees. The city has expressed concerns about needing more emergency service employees as calls have become more consistent in Bridgeport.

item.title: Man admits to placing card skimmer in Clarksburg grocery store
item.description: A man has admitted to placing credit card skimming devices in several retailers across north central West Virginia, including Clarksburg, the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) announced Thursday.

item.title: Doddridge County couple charged after 2 kids found in 'extreme deplorable living conditions'
item.description: A pair has been arrested and is facing charges after deputies with the Doddridge County Sheriff's Department say children in their care were found living in "extreme deplorable living conditions."

item.title: Man tased after allegedly fleeing from Marion County deputies
item.description: A man has been arrested and is facing charges after deputies with the Marion County Sheriff's Department say he fled from them and nearly struck one with his vehicle.

item.title: West Virginia Democrats seek to put cannabis legalization on public ballot
item.description: After years of their legalization efforts being blocked by the Republican majority, House Democrats have said they've filed paperwork to bring the public referendum process to the state.

item.title: 2 charged after victim shot 5 times in Randolph County: WVSP
item.description: Two men have been arrested and are facing charges in Randolph County after troopers with the West Virginia State Police say a man was shot five times.

item.title: Wreck on I-79 in southern Harrison County sends 2 to hospital
item.description: Two people were taken to the hospital Friday afternoon following a wreck on Interstate 79 in Harrison County.

item.title: Student arrested after allegedly air dropping shooters list at Buckhannon-Upshur Middle School
item.description: Buckhannon-Upshur Middle School was placed on lockdown on Friday and a student is in custody after they allegedly distributed a shooter's list to other students.
